This feels right, and I like it. One field at the top where I paste and hit "Add link," then it shows me what it found before saving — that's exactly the kind of flow I was hoping for. And it did pull in all the things I care about: the title, the little description, the site name and its icon, and a picture. Seeing those laid out means I can actually recognize the link, which is the whole point.

One thing I noticed on that "Here's what we found" step: it's showing me the details, but I can't touch them. Sometimes the title a page gives itself is clunky or too long, or the description isn't quite what I'd want to remember it by. So on that review step, before I hit save, I'd want to be able to fix up the title or the description myself. And ideally I could still tweak them later too, after it's saved, if I change my mind.

Otherwise, yes — this direction is spot on.
